name: scan-upgrade-wrap
description: scan-upgrade with a wrapped scan counter (ergoplatform/ergo#1668): before the upgrade the v6.0.8 release registers filler scans until its Short counter passes 32767, then two scans it numbers -32768 and -32767 (the miner's reward script), and adds one confirmed reward box to both with /scan/addBox. After the upgrade: pass = the release's answers for every scan it can serve, kept (as scan-upgrade); wrapped_supported = the wrapped scans are listed, hold the added box, gain a box per new block, and the next scan gets 32768. A jar that keeps the Short id (base) is expected to leave the wrapped scans unlisted: wrapped_supported false; the candidate (Long ids with the Short range kept): true.
